title: Check, fix or refresh the reference data
caption: tools/reference-data/README.md, ADR-0024. Refreshes are quarterly pull requests; CI, deploys and tests never download.

steps.title: Check offline
steps.expect: Exit 0; non-zero if a file breaks a rule, its SHA-256 differs from `SOURCES.md` (hand edit) or `data/` reaches 3 MB.

steps.title: Urgent fix of one value
steps.body: Add `airports,XYZ,name,Example International Airport` to `data/overrides.csv` (never edit the generated CSVs).
steps.expect: `validate.mjs` accepts it (key must exist, value must pass the column rules).

steps.title: Load
steps.expect: `reference.loaded` with `overrides: 1` and `updated: 1` for that table; a second load reports zeros.

steps.title: Refresh (quarterly)
steps.body: `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node tools/reference-data/scripts/fetch.mjs` on Node 24, review `git diff --stat tools/reference-data`, run the tests, open a PR.
steps.expect: Stops, writing nothing, if a licence changed or a table is below its minimum rows.

steps.title: On the VM
steps.body: Reloads only when the SHA-256 of `data/` changed (`/var/lib/velexis/reference-data.sha256`).
steps.expect: A failed load stops the deploy before the switch.
